reason: Fixes a process-group reaping bug in the generated template's own 'Start dev server' / 'Stop dev server' steps (wawagardenbar-app#925): `npm run dev &` is backgrounded without `set -m`, so the job isn't in its own process group, and the stop step's plain `kill "$PID"` only ever signals that one tracked PID. When `npm run dev` is a wrapper spawning `next dev` as a child, the wrapper exits on SIGTERM but the real server process is never signaled -- it's orphaned and accumulates across job runs until the self-hosted runner's memory cap is hit (this caused a real week-long crash/restart loop on this runner, Oct 9-16 2026). Fix: `set -m` on start, process-group kill (`kill -TERM -- "-$PID"`) with plain-kill and `pkill -9 -P` fallbacks on stop. This is the narrowly-scoped immediate fix for the template's own two steps (used by the critical/scoped-dispatch path and before e2e/ci-reliability/regression-run.sh's sharded path takes over, if present); the durable fix belongs in DevAudit-Installer's cli/src/update/ci-templates.ts (buildE2eRegressionServerStep and its stop-step builder) -- tracked upstream, drop this patch once that ships.
